newPost.title: New post
newPost.policyIntro: Posts document problems so they get fixed. A moderator checks every post against these rules:

policy.facts: Stick to facts: what, where (tower or common area) and when.
policy.promise: Say what was promised (brochure, agreement, approved plan) and what exists instead.
policy.people: No names, faces, phone numbers or other personal details of employees or private people.
policy.tone: No abusive language, no threats, and no accusations of crimes you cannot prove.
policy.review: Nothing is shown until a moderator publishes it; posts that break these rules are not published.
policy.anonymous: Others see "Verified resident" and, only if you choose, your tower. Never your name.

help.title: How to use the app
help.lead: Short guides for what you can do here. Tap a topic to open it.
help.more: Still stuck? Ask your society office or tower admin.

start.title: Getting started
start.1: Sign in with your mobile number: we send a 6-digit code by SMS. It signs you in as soon as you type the last digit.
start.2: The first time, tell us your name and your flat (tower, floor, flat; owner or tenant) and send it for approval. The society admin checks it, usually within a day.
start.3: Choose English, हिन्दी or मराठी at the top of any screen. The app remembers it on this phone.
start.4: Use the tabs at the bottom (or at the top on a computer). Your profile, this help and sign out are under Profile.

feed.title: Reading the feed
feed.1: The feed shows problems residents of your society and nearby societies have documented, after a moderator has checked them.
feed.2: Posts show "Verified resident" and the society, and the tower only if the writer chose to. Names are never shown.
feed.3: Tap a post to see every photo. If it names a person, shares private details or is not factual, use "Report this post". Three reports hide it until a moderator looks.

post.title: Writing a post
post.1: On the feed, tap "New post". Read the rules first: facts only, what was promised and what exists, no names or faces of people.
post.2: Write what the problem is and the details: where, since when, and what the brochure or agreement promised.
post.3: Add up to 5 photos. The app removes their location data before sending. Choose whether to show your tower.
post.4: Tap "Send for review". Nobody sees it until a moderator publishes it. Follow it, and the moderator's reason if it is not published, under "My posts".

complaint.title: Raising and following a complaint
complaint.1: Under Complaints, tap "Raise a complaint". Add photos if you can: they help staff see the problem before they come.
complaint.2: Choose the kind of problem and where it is: your flat, or a common area (a tower or the whole society). Then describe it.
complaint.3: Follow it on its page: who it is assigned to, every step under "What happened", and comments. Add a comment if something changes.
complaint.4: When staff mark it resolved, check the fix. If the problem is gone, tap "Yes, it is fixed. Close it". If not, add a comment.

jobs.title: Doing your jobs (staff)
jobs.1: Jobs lists the complaints assigned to you, the most urgent first.
jobs.2: Open a job and tap "Start work" when you begin, so the resident knows it is being handled.
jobs.3: When done, tap "Mark as resolved" and say what was done (for example: replaced the tap washer). You can add a photo of the fix.

shift.title: Starting and ending your shift (staff)
shift.1: On Jobs, tap "Start shift" when you begin work. The first time, the app explains what it records.
shift.2: Take a selfie with the front camera. The app also records where your phone is at that moment, and only then.
shift.3: Tap "End shift" when you finish, with a new selfie. If you were outside the society or your location was off, your admin will look at it.
shift.4: "My performance" shows your complaints, how fast you fixed them, and your shift hours.

assign.title: Assigning complaints (admins)
assign.1: "To assign" lists new complaints, the most urgent first. Tower admins see their own tower.
assign.2: Open one and choose who should fix it. The staff member sees it under Jobs at once.
assign.3: If it is not a real problem, use "Reject this complaint" and give the reason; the resident sees it.

review.title: Staff report and shifts (admins)
review.1: Profile, Manage, Staff report: per staff member, complaints assigned and fixed, how fast, how many on time, and shift hours.
review.2: Profile, Manage, Review shifts: compare both selfies with the staff member and check where they were. Flagged shifts have a red edge.
review.3: Tap "Confirm", or "Dispute" with a reason. You cannot review your own shift.

moderate.title: Moderating the feed (society admin)
moderate.1: The feed shows how many posts wait for review; tap it, or go to Profile, Manage, Feed moderation.
moderate.2: Publish posts that follow the rules. For others, choose "Do not publish" and give a reason: the writer sees it.
moderate.3: "Hidden by reports" lists posts that readers reported three times. Publish them again or remove them.

signups.title: Approving sign-ups (society admin)
signups.1: Sign-ups lists people who registered for a flat, with their name, flat and mobile number.
signups.2: Check they live there, then approve, or choose "Do not approve" and give the reason they will see.

addons.title: Turning parts of the app on or off
addons.1: Profile, Manage, Add-ons: switch the Feed or Complaints on or off for everyone in the society.
addons.2: Switching off hides it; nothing is deleted. Switching it on again brings everything back.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.1: Only your name, mobile number and flat are kept. Other residents see names, never mobile numbers.
privacy.2: Feed posts never show who wrote them.
privacy.3: Photos are resized and their location data removed on your phone before upload.
privacy.4: Staff selfies and shift locations are deleted after 90 days.
